### Field Descriptions for UE CONTEXT SUSPEND RESPONSE

**Functional Role:** This message is sent by the MME to indicate to the eNB the UE context and the related bearer contexts have been suspended.
**Direction:** MME → eNB

| Functional Role | Data Type | Presence/Need Code | Value Range |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Message Type | Message Type (ref. 9.2.1.1) | M (Mandatory) | Not specified |
| MME UE S1AP ID | MME-UE-S1AP-ID (ref. 9.2.3.3) | M (Mandatory) | Not specified |
| eNB UE S1AP ID | ENB-UE-S1AP-ID (ref. 9.2.3.4) | M (Mandatory) | Not specified |
| CSG Membership Status | CSGMembershipStatus (ref. 9.2.1.73) | O (Optional) | Not specified |
| Criticality Diagnostics | CriticalityDiagnostics (ref. 9.2.1.21) | O (Optional) | Not specified |

```asn.1
UEContextSuspendResponse ::= SEQUENCE {

    { ID id-CSGMembershipStatus  CRITICALITY ignore TYPE CSGMembershipStatus PRESENCE optional}|
    { ID id-CriticalityDiagnostics  CRITICALITY ignore TYPE CriticalityDiagnostics PRESENCE optional},
    ...
}
```
